sn45.170:1.5: imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave, tissannaṃ taṇhānaṃ abhiññāya -pe- pariññāya -pe- parikkhayāya -pe- pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo.
sn45.170:1.7: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti -pe- sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti. vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn45.170:1.8: imāsaṃ kho bhikkhave, tissannaṃ taṇhānaṃ abhiññāya -pe- pariññāya -pe- parikkhayāya -pe- pahānāya ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabboti.
